_comment: MMClaude configuration for MiniMax M3. Token Plan usage is tracked locally by tokens and polled live; cost fields stay zero.
_fastModelNote: Background work uses MiniMax-M2.5 with thinking when available, falling back to MiniMax-M2.7-highspeed with thinking; images and video stay native on M3.
_modelIsASentinelNote: model and fastModel name local profiles. Profiles resolve to the configured MiniMax M3/M2.x model IDs.

effort._comment: MiniMax M3 thinking is binary: none/low become thinking disabled, while medium/high/xhigh/ultra/max become thinking adaptive. M2.x profiles are kept thinking-enabled. Ultracode keeps the parent M3 thorough, while helper fan-out stays on the quota-friendly background profile.

rates._comment: MiniMax Token Plan is quota/usage based rather than a local dollar budget. Zero rates avoid inventing a local price.

cap._comment: Disabled. MiniMax enforces Token Plan quota; MMClaude reports local token usage and live remaining quota.

balance._comment: Token Plan quota is polled separately from the local token ledger. MiniMax documents a separate pay-as-you-go key for bypassing a request limit; MMClaude never silently changes billing mode.

trafficPolicy._comment: Conservative Max Token Plan defaults: keep two agent lanes, one background lane, and pace starts so ultracode/swarm fan-out queues instead of exhausting the rolling quota.

pausePolicy._comment: When the live Token Plan interval reaches this remaining percentage or reports exhausted, keep Claude requests open until end_time and then refresh. This preserves long-running goals across the 5-hour rolling window; the shim never silently switches to a separate pay-as-you-go key.

desktop._comment: Claude-looking logical tiers all resolve to MiniMax-M3; the displayed names describe the tier, not a different upstream model.

_timezoneNote: Empty means the host's own zone via Intl.

vision._comment: Disabled intentionally. MiniMax M3 accepts native image and video blocks through the Anthropic-compatible endpoint.

modelProfiles._comment: M3 uses disabled/adaptive thinking; M2.x profiles are explicitly thinking-enabled. The local profile names keep Claude Code's tier routing stable.
